children: ArcBest provided Q3 2026 operating and financial updates, noting strong Asset-Light revenue growth and an expected $10–12 million non-GAAP operating income for Asset‑Light.
Asset‑Based billed revenue/day up ~8% QTD through Aug; tonnage/day up ~9% while shipments/day down ~4% — heavier freight profile drives revenue gains.
ABF’s non‑GAAP operating ratio for Q3 expected to be generally consistent with Q2 2026; no significant GAAP vs non‑GAAP difference currently expected.
Asset‑Light revenue/day up ~27% QTD; revenue/ship up ~22% and purchased transportation ~85% of revenue.
Company expects Asset‑Light GAAP operating income $8M–$10M; excluding ~$2M purchase accounting amortization, non‑GAAP operating income $10M–$12M for Q3.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
